name: Curlew Community Food Pantry
notes: Free food; no SNAP purchase required. Serves North Ferry County. Walk-ins; closed holidays. Not open every Thursday. Alternate contact: 509-846-3138. Call to confirm.

name: Danville Outpost
notes: General store with groceries; located in Danville, outside ZIP 99118. SNAP retailer listed by USDA. Closed Sunday.

name: Ferry County Co-op
notes: In Republic, outside ZIP 99118. Winter hours start first Monday in October. Summer hours differ, including Sunday opening; call to confirm. No membership required to shop. Closed New Year's Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas.
